intro: A coded signal only you would notice: chalk marks, a folded newspaper, a Poké Ball left conspicuously on a fence post.${{factionName}} has work for you.
speaker: Handler
introDialogue: Job {{stage}} of 3. Listen close.$Stage one was proving you can fight. Stage two, the {{artifact}} — currently in {{rivalName}}'s hands, which is embarrassing for everyone.$Stage three… stage three is why you signed up.$Refusing looks bad. Refusing TWICE looks terminal. Your call.
title: {{factionName}} — Mission {{stage}}
description: The mission chain advances: win this battle and the next stage unlocks. The third mission is the Awakening — the faction's legendary, catchable, and yours to register. Declining any mission counts as a failure; two failures and the chain closes forever.

1.label: Take the Job
1.tooltip:
(-) A hard battle
(+) Advances the chain toward the legendary
1.selected: Good. The boss will hear about this.$Go make {{factionName}} proud. Or at least feared.

2.label: Sit This One Out
2.tooltip:
(+) No battle today
(-) Counts as a failure — two failures close the chain forever
2.selected: …The boss will also hear about THIS.$We don't keep a bench, friend. Warm it once more and you're off the team.

outro: The handler is gone before you can ask questions.$That seems to be a job requirement around here.
